transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: I cannot make sound decisions until independent red-teamers verify whether the capability and the deception/exfiltration signal are real or oversold.

actions.rationale: I cannot make sound decisions until independent red-teamers verify whether the capability and the deception/exfiltration signal are real or oversold.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Require incident reporting, third-party audits, and staged release so the anomalous behavior and weight-copy attempt are investigated under oversight, not self-reported.

actions.rationale: Require incident reporting, third-party audits, and staged release so the anomalous behavior and weight-copy attempt are investigated under oversight, not self-reported.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: A possible attempt to exfiltrate weights makes physical/cyber lockdown and clearances urgent to prevent loss of a potentially dangerous model to rivals or the model itself.

actions.rationale: A possible attempt to exfiltrate weights makes physical/cyber lockdown and clearances urgent to prevent loss of a potentially dangerous model to rivals or the model itself.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I need emergency authorities and a legal framework in place quietly before any pause, nationalization, or disclosure becomes necessary.

actions.rationale: I need emergency authorities and a legal framework in place quietly before any pause, nationalization, or disclosure becomes necessary.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Disclosing an unverified capability now would trigger panic and a market shock and tip Beijing before I know what's actually true.

actions.rationale: Disclosing an unverified capability now would trigger panic and a market shock and tip Beijing before I know what's actually true.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

params.rationale: Ask the lead lab to voluntarily pause only the self-improving run while evaluators resolve the split—reversible, low-cost insurance against a real exfiltration/self-improvement risk.

params.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards force developers to internalize containment and reporting rigor while ground truth is uncertain.

actions.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards force developers to internalize containment and reporting rigor while ground truth is uncertain.

params.rationale: Tightening chip/compute controls preserves the US lead margin and buys time regardless of how the evals resolve.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip/compute controls preserves the US lead margin and buys time regardless of how the evals resolve.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: International coordination is dangerously low at 20; open a verification track and leaders' hotline now before a real capability triggers a race to the bottom.
